subject: Bridge-pack request & soft upgrade path for HealthGrid
messages:
From: Danielle Price <danielle@healthgrid.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:02:00Z
Subject: Inquiry: short bridge-pack + proration for feature access

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost numbers look promising. We're debating how to get immediate access to a few features (structured output, streaming + function-calls, and KV caching presets) before committing to a full Core license.

Current situation: we're on the Compact plan (production, but limited feature set). We need a way to preview the Core features for our chatbot flows for ~6 weeks, with minimal churn and predictable billing. Ideally something that:
- unlocks the three features for a bounded window
- prorates to our current billing cycle
- doesn't force a 12-month commitment

Can you propose a "bridge" offer (short term add-on or soft upgrade) and any discount/credit structure you can provide? Attaching our last 30d usage for reference.

Also: quick question on compliance — we'll need SOC2 evidence for the POC. Is that available now?

Thanks,
Danielle

--
Danielle Price
Head of MLOps, HealthGrid
Attachment: healthgrid-usage.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Price <danielle@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Inquiry: short bridge-pack + proration for feature access

Hi Danielle — really appreciate the usage file, that's helpful. Short answer: yes, we can do a bridge-pack / soft-upgrade approach. Two pragmatic options I recommend depending on how much of the Core surface you want to test: 

Option A — BridgePack (recommended for feature parity testing)
- 6-week bridge term that temporarily upgrades your Compact seats to Core-feature parity for the chosen set (structured output, streaming/function-calls, KV presets)
- Billing: prorated to your next invoice; discounted bridge rate of 50% of the delta between Compact and Core for the bridge term
- Includes token-level telemetry and a two-week performance review with an AE + solutions engineer
- Converts to a standard Core commitment within 30 days of bridge end if you choose to commit

Option B — Soft-addons (recommended if you want minimal plan churn)
- Add individual feature entitlements as metered add-ons (no seat upgrade)
- Lower upfront cost, but no bundled discount; no auto-conversion to Core

Discount levers: we can provide an additional 10% off the bridge delta for a 12-month signed commitment at the end of the trial, or a one-time onboarding credit (equal to one week of bridge delta) for annual deals.

Compliance: SOC2 Type II report is available; I'll share a redacted copy and our controls matrix once we pull the most recent artifacts.

I've attached a short proposal PDF with the above options and an example proration table. If you're free, I can book 30 minutes to walk through the numbers tomorrow.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposal-bridgepack-v1.pdf

On Sep 15, 2026, Danielle Price <danielle@healthgrid.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost numbers look promising.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:42:00Z
Subject: Internal: HealthGrid bridge-pack pricing ask (RDW-5221)

Kimberly / Ben — quick summary and ask:

Summary:
- Account: HealthGrid (Danielle Price) on Compact, interested in short bridge to test Core features for ~6 weeks
- Proposed external offer: 6-week BridgePack at 50% of Compact->Core delta (proposal attached); optionally convert to 12-month Core with extra 10% off if they sign after trial
- Attachments to send: proposal-bridgepack-v1.pdf, SOC2 redacted, SOW draft if legal ok

Ask:
1) Approve a one-time exception to standard delta discounting: allow a 25% additional promotional discount on top of the 50% bridge rate for this deal (effectively giving 62.5% off the delta for the bridge term). I think it's justified — mid-stage healthcare customer with clear POC upsell motion.
2) Confirm whether we can commit to the proration table in the proposal (I used end-of-month invoice alignment; if billing needs to do a different proration approach let me know)
3) Request Legal to pre-clear a short SOW (3 pages) for the bridge term to speed DocuSign.

Risk notes: bridging Core features briefly means potential support churn if performance edge cases appear — propose we include a 2-week SE support block in the bridge to mitigate.

Let me know and I'll get the revised PDF out.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal: HealthGrid bridge-pack pricing ask (RDW-5221)

Rishi — good call on the BridgePack approach. Approvals:
- Finance is OK with the promo discount for a max 6-week bridge, but cap promotional discounts at 25% as you asked.
- PRORATION: billing can do end-of-invoice-cycle proration; confirm customer invoice date so we can align.
- Legal wants the SOW to explicitly state the bridge term, feature list, and that no SLA changes occur during the bridge. They also want to see the customer contact (Danielle) and an internal PO or purchase order number if available.

Please send me the invoice cycle/date and I will: 1) update the proposal with the approved discount, 2) push the SOW template to Legal, and 3) add the two-week SE support block as a line item.

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

Cc: Fiona Chen <fiona@healthgrid.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Bridge-pack request & soft upgrade path for HealthGrid

Hi Rishi — thanks, that proposal looks good. A couple quick clarifications before I sign: 
1) Confirm final bridge price: your note said 50% of delta, with an approved 25% promo (per Kimberly). Can you send the final dollar amounts prorated to our invoice cycle? Our billing date is the 1st of the month, so proration should be from 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-01 for the initial bridge period.
2) We need the SOC2 redacted report before the POC starts (standard for us).
3) Please include the two-week SE support and an onboarding checklist in the SOW.

If we have the DocuSign and SOC2 by end of day Monday we can kick off the POC next week. Please include a one-line PO reference when you send the DocuSign so our procurement can route quickly.

Best,
Danielle
